_comment: ALL SEVEN topological_offset cases are commented out -- the file names are parked in _commented_out below, and their configs are still in this directory. Nothing here runs. The 2D three (topological_offset_2d, _2d_vertex_input, _2d_dragon) came out first, while 2D was reworked to match 3D. The 3D three came out with them: the 2D and 3D optimizations now share one flow, and neither converges on the ESP-based offset potential, so registering them would only assert a known failure. Their configs also still carry keys the current topological_offset spec has deleted, and the spec is strict, so they would fail to parse. topological_offset_2d_two_circles is the newest and is different in kind: its config DOES parse against the current spec (checked key by key, 2026-08-22), and it is parked because the case FAILS, not because it cannot be read. It is the 2D interference fixture -- two unit circles whose centres are exactly 2 + 2*target_distance apart, so at target_distance 0.1 the two offsets are EXACTLY TANGENT at the origin and the offset is a pinched figure-eight. It is here because that is the case the 2D work is stuck on, and a fixture nobody can load is a fixture nobody can reproduce. Re-add a name to integration_tests once its config parses against the spec and the case is expected to pass; the group is hidden ([.]) either way, so run it explicitly with ./wmtk_integration_tests "[offset]".
